message.Title: Public Preview: Claude in Microsoft Foundry

Body.Content: Claude models by Anthropic are now available for Public Preview in Microsoft Foundry, expanding the platform’s unified ecosystem of frontier AI. Enterprises can access Claude Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1, and Haiku 4.5 for advanced long-context reasoning, coding, and multimodal comprehension—integrated across Foundry Models, Playground, and Agent Service. Importantly, Claude is offered within the global standard deployment type, ensuring that organizations can leverage these models with consistent availability, enterprise-grade support, and compliance across worldwide Azure regions. This makes it straightforward for customers to deploy and scale Claude-powered solutions wherever they operate, benefiting from Microsoft’s trusted infrastructure and governance. This launch marks a major milestone in Microsoft’s open, interoperable AI strategy, empowering customers to build agentic systems, automate workflows, and ground Claude in enterprise data with full observability, security, and Responsible AI. With Claude joining over 11,000 other models, Foundry offers the broadest model choice and seamless integration with Azure services, making it the only enterprise platform to unify all major model families in one governed environment.
